summary.headline: Codex Entries 417–431
summary.text: Catalog entries 417–431 of a Florentine astrological codex, including palmistry, eclipses, planetary terms according to Ptolemy, timing predictions, lunar conjunctions, celestial spheres, Persian eclipses, horoscope scarcity, the four angles, planetary and zodiacal rulerships of cities, names, elements, and eclipses of the lights. The entries cite folios 292v–301 and include a 1345 genethlialogical horoscope for a Venetian man.
